metadata.purpose: Show measured/model-supported durations and diagnostic qualifications without a forced physical classification or composite BH score
limitations: Catalog labels are publication/selection labels, not independent truth labels. Some events appear in multiple catalogs or model modes.
Common day units do not make different model/frame conventions identical. Distinct lanes retain their provenance.
Within-lane jitter is for visual separation only, not uncertainty or an additional physical coordinate.
Scalar nonrejection and reduced chi-square do not establish lensing versus variable stars or black-hole mass.
All missing data, fit failures, boundaries and alternative modes are retained. Unavailable quantities are not plotted at invented locations.
Source type STAR/GALAXY/AGN_QUASAR/UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS is distinct from foreground lens identity. No galaxy/quasar source is automatically excluded.
No accepted new mass interval, known-BH recovery or new black-hole result is claimed.

SIMBAD/CDS and NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED); native exact-identifier/cone-query provenance and all matches retained separately from source/lens inference.
metadata.BHSM_interpretation: In the author's BHSM interpretation, gravitational geometry is spacetime-side surface topography of a common system. Validated ordinary gravitational lensing can constrain its exterior imprint without requiring a departure from GR. One exterior optical response is counted once. The present evidence stages do not uniquely determine microscopic interface dynamics, core states or horizons.

source_score_spectrum.score_transform: log1p(score / 1e-6) for display only; zero is retained exactly; no score is normalized or reinterpreted
source_score_spectrum.qualification: All five native DSC Combmod scores, without renormalization. No verified source type, lens identity or BH probability is inferred. Only exact 363 published Gaia source IDs are displayed; contextual neighbors remain separate.
source_score_spectrum.acknowledgements: ESA/Gaia/DPAC and AIP Gaia DR3, CC BY-NC3.0 IGO; DSC Delchambre et al.2023 A&A674 A31, arXiv2206.06710; calibration context Jamal & Bailer-Jones2024 A&A687 A258, arXiv2405.01340

catalog_source_evidence.native_Gaia_release: DR3; unrelated DR4 preview is a separate validation record
catalog_source_evidence.qualification: Catalog/source-role labels are metadata, not independently validated classes. No threshold assignment, nearest adoption or source-type-only exclusion. Keep unknowns, ambiguity and every raw native neighbor.
catalog_source_evidence.query_status_qualification: Inherited raw membership query_status is original roster metadata. Nested service-specific statuses and completed manifests describe the completed acquisition.

investigation_taxonomy.assignment: Existing unresolved foreground identity; independent of background source type.

metadata.previous_v8_BHSM_interpretation: One ordinary compact-lens Einstein/GHY exterior counted once. The spectrum does not measure a core, membrane deformation or horizon.

bhsm_surface_framework.author_definition: Well, BHSM surface deformation is any topographical surface deformation that gravity is. So any bubble, envelope, encapsulation event is evidence of a hypersurface.
bhsm_surface_framework.scope: Author interpretation; not a new proved field equation or identification from a conditional fit.
bhsm_surface_framework.common_geometry: Spacetime-side gravitational topography, organized configurations and interfaces belong to the common BHSM framework.

data_rights_and_attribution.scope: Derived tracker results and factual catalog/model metadata, with source-row identities, citations and native query metadata.
data_rights_and_attribution.native_observation_reproduction: Original observation files remain separately sourced; their hashes and provenance do not grant redistribution rights.

rules.purpose: Explore whether several historical microlensing events could be due to one moving foreground object, without assuming source positions are lens positions or assigning a BH identity.
rules.root_approval: All / Track test supported / Track data unavailable; optional model-timescale and measured-geometry thresholds with unknowns retained; opt-in source-event sequence context; no seeded scientific subset.
rules.preservation: Every original v9 point field, exact Potential black hole category, physical null, native metadata/provenance, evidence stage and all four scientific figures remain unchanged.

filter.label: Moving-lens track inputs
filter.admission_scope: No actual angular lens track or admitted source-event-offset reconstruction is present in this snapshot. Availability is not a BH classification or negative lens detection.
filter.new_measured_track_admission: Not implemented in this metadata view; independently admitted measured angular JSON analysis is a separate installed /skytrack workspace.

te_max.role: Exploratory model crossing-time maximum, not proper motion or mass

distance_max.role: Measured lens distance only; source parallax is not substituted

motion_min.role: Measured relative lens-source angular speed only

theta_max.role: Measured angular Einstein scale only; brightness amplitude is not this quantity

thresholds.invalid_threshold_policy: Explicit error and export refusal until corrected; no silent reset or negative classification
thresholds.DOM_invalid_input: HTML number-control badInput is an explicit error even if the browser exposes an empty value; export is refused.
thresholds.number_lexemes: Blank, or positive finite decimal/exponent HTML-number grammar only; no hexadecimal, leading plus, trailing point, whitespace, underflow or overflow. Python and JavaScript helpers use matching grammar.

sequence_collection.selection: User opt-in per model point_id; initially empty; no automatic or named-target seed
sequence_collection.sky_display: Catalog source/event RA and Dec markers only; no connecting line, fitted line, lens-position substitution or physical angular speed
sequence_collection.time_policy: Show model anchor raw value, numeric origin, reference and definition; order only within each native group. No common-clock conversion, fake lens epoch or t0-versus-t0star substitution.

view_export_replay.JSON: Dataset identity, complete metadata, all filter thresholds, selected case ID, sequence point IDs, displayed IDs, displayed records and sequence records retained.
view_export_replay.CSV: Standard quoted CSV with __record_kind and __view_state_json columns: exactly one VIEW_STATE metadata row followed by the union of displayed and hidden-sequence POINT rows, once per point ID. Ordinary complete snapshot CSV remains a separate unchanged-purpose tabulation.
view_export_replay.replay: Local UTF-8 JSON/CSV, exact frozen dataset identity and canonical record/value/order checks before applying state; no new model call or replacement of the full built-in dataset.
view_export_replay.failed_unresolved_hidden_cases: Remain in the full frozen dataset. Explicit filter/selection state is preserved; unavailable geometry is retained by numeric thresholds.
view_export_replay.selected_case_contract: Selected case must be displayed or explicitly retained in the opt-in sequence; a hidden sequence case remains selected across exact JSON/CSV replay without changing filters.
view_export_replay.complete_JSON_guard: Exact canonical metadata and array-typed displayed/sequence records are mandatory. Nonfinite numbers anywhere in the envelope are refused before canonical comparison.
view_export_replay.CSV_validation: An internal CSV_STATE mode validates the compact metadata row; exact native record strings are checked, then full frozen metadata and arrays are materialized and passed through complete-envelope validation.
view_export_replay.selection_transition: Clearing or removing the last membership of a hidden selected case clears only that selected case; filters and all other sequence members remain. A displayed selected case may remain selected.

navigation.label: Open moving-lens workspace (installed app)
navigation.standalone_qualification: The installed-app route is separate from a standalone/offline metadata snapshot.

rules.method_distinction: Single-lens/rectilinear fitting is a model assumption. A common lens, angular linearity, compactness, distance, mass and BH identity are not inferred from short duration or source alignment.

points.source_class_basis: Qualified catalog identifier/source-role evidence; native types and all contextual neighbors retained. Catalog label is not independent physical truth or foreground-lens identity.
points.interval_qualification: Published joint-model uncertainty only; not tracker recovery or classification probability
points.time_convention: tE star = thetaE / absolute value of relative lens-source proper motion
points.NED_qualification: Legacy NED route excludes data ingested after January2026; no hit is not an exclusion.

native_catalog_membership_evidence.source_type_qualification: Catalog identifier or primary-literature association only; source/lens role and angular counterpart require separate validation. Scores and nearby objects are not verified types.

previously_pinned_four_target_evidence.elimination_reason: Already a published BH interpretation; retain as known-system benchmark.
notes: Catalog star/source type does not classify a foreground lens.
Query aperture is contextual, not an association confidence interval; source epoch/uncertainty were unavailable.
No closest Gaia or NED object is adopted solely from position. Gaia native2016.0 epoch is retained without propagation.
DSC scores use catalog data/model priors and do not measure a lens type, lens mass or BH probability.
NED no-hit does not establish absence of a galaxy/AGN source or a dark lens.

The source is a published late-type subgiant (Sahu2025 section5). The literature-positive BH label applies to its separate foreground lens; tracker recovery remains NOT_ESTABLISHED. The close Gaia/NED objects are not adopted as the source automatically.
